pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/Baseline/useBaseline.ts:185 When labGrade finds no checker, the write-through posts `pass`. For checker-less steps the server keeps that producer status, adding only an `UNGRADED:` reason (pipeline-artifacts route), and `settlementOf` returns 'nothing to settle' for any `pass`. A hole in the grader's vision is therefore stored and counted as compliance.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/Baseline/useBaseline.ts:185 A missing grader is the gate's own blindness and should fail closed or be refused. Here it defaults to pass, and rollups count it from `status`.
src/components/layout-lab/labAcceptance.ts:41 The lab resolves checkers in the server's order, so the on-screen projection can only be at or below the server verdict.
src/components/layout-lab/Baseline/useBaseline.ts:180 A checker that throws records an unsynced reason and posts nothing. It is never folded into a pass.
src/components/layout-lab/Baseline/useBaseline.ts:157 A sync failure carries the server's actionable reason plus a Retry, not a bare flag.
src/components/layout-lab/batchDrainModel.ts:51 An outage of the external judge or editor is counted as `deferred`, not condemned as fail.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/lib/catalog/acceptance/pythonDrain.ts:118 A literal NUL byte in this template string makes git classify pythonDrain.ts as binary (`git ls-files --eol` prints `i/-text`, numstat prints `- -`) and makes grep report 'Binary file matches'. Every diff review and text search of the python-step drain is blind while the file still compiles and ships. Separately, the drain skips any step whose producer-written data already carries `ok`/`created`, so the gate reads evidence the gated producer authors.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/catalog/acceptance/pythonDrain.ts:118 One raw control byte drops the file out of every text gate and diff. A `\u0000` escape would keep it text.
src/lib/catalog/acceptance/pythonDrain.ts:55 The 'already drained' test, and pythonStepOk's pass on `data.ok === true`, read fields any producer POST can write. The editor module then never runs.
src/lib/catalog/acceptance/pythonDrain.ts:156 With no checker the drain writes nothing and reports not-gradable. It never defaults to pass.
src/lib/catalog/acceptance/pythonDrain.ts:145 A transport failure has its own outcome (bridge-error), separate from pass and fail.
src/lib/catalog/acceptance/pythonDrain.ts:20 A live-editor (external) failure resolves to could-not-run, not to a condemnation.

src/lib/catalog/acceptance/judgeBridge.ts:32 Verdicts are bound to a content hash and rubric version, with a closed vocabulary: current/stale/superseded/unknown.
